items.quote: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:
items.claim: The text says Moses and Aaron told all the children of Israel that by evening they would know the LORD had brought them out of Egypt.

items.quote: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD;
items.claim: The text says the Israelites were told they would see the glory of the LORD in the morning.

items.quote: This shall be, when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full;
items.claim: The text says Moses announced that the LORD would give the people meat in the evening and plenty of bread in the morning.
items.object: flesh in the evening and bread in the morning
items.mechanism: divine provision of food (the text's own framing)

items.quote: your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.
items.claim: The text says Moses told the people that their complaints were really against the LORD, not against Moses and Aaron.
items.object: the murmurings of the children of Israel
